verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Nitrokey 3 ships FIDO2 (nitrokey-docs-16, nitrokey-docs-1) and is marketed for passwordless Microsoft/Entra ID login (nitrokey-docs-4, nitrokey-docs-18). Such login implies some on-device user verification, but nothing in the pack explicitly documents a FIDO2 PIN or a biometric sensor. The only verification-related item, touch confirmation (nitrokey-docs-6), is user presence rather than user verification, and it is documented for OpenPGP. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a FIDO2 PIN (clientPIN/UV) on the key, any built-in biometric option, evidence that a stolen key is blocked without the PIN (e.g., retry lockout), and independent hands-on corroboration.
